Package com.bupt.ta.service

Class ProfileService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.ProfileService
public class ProfileService extends Object
Persistence and validation helpers for applicant profiles in profiles.json.

Stores personal fields, education JSON, skills/courses, availability, and CV filename. On save, basic identity fields can be synced back to users.json via AuthService. Profile completeness gates job application and AI matching features.

Also provides buildAiCapabilityText(com.bupt.ta.model.ApplicantProfile) and hasAiMatchingInput(com.bupt.ta.model.ApplicantProfile) for LM prompts.
